name: Ranged Attack
featureDescription: A basic ranged attack.

effects.actionDescription: You fire a projectile at a target within range.

name: Melee Attack
featureDescription: A basic melee strike.

effects.actionDescription: You strike a creature within reach.

name: Physical Resistance
featureDescription: Take Half damage from Physical attacks.

name: Battle Hardened
featureDescription: Battle-scarred discipline hardens the creature's defenses.

name: Iron Hide
featureDescription: Thick plating bolsters the creature's hide.

name: Bash
featureDescription: Bash a grappled creature into the ground.

effects.actionDescription: You slam your weapon down on a Grappled creature with crushing force.

save.failure: The target is knocked Prone.

name: Covering Fire
featureDescription: A ranged AoE attack that causes Bleeding on failed saves.

effects.actionDescription: You loose a volley of arrows that blanket the area, striking every creature within.

save.failure: The target gains the Bleeding condition.

name: Nature's Healing
featureDescription: Long range single target healing.

effects.actionDescription: You mend the wounds of a creature within range.

name: Translocate
featureDescription: Short range teleport, navigating the Fey Plane.

effects.actionDescription: You step through the Fey Plane, disappearing and reappearing in an unoccupied space within 3 Spaces.

name: Entangling Vines
featureDescription: Create Difficult terrain.

effects.actionDescription: The area becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute.

name: Umbral Blast
featureDescription: A magical AoE attack that deals Umbral and True damage.

name: Pack Instincts
featureDescription: The creature thrives when fighting alongside allies.

effects.text: Gain ADV on attack rolls when an ally is adjacent to the target.

name: Fishhook Shot
featureDescription: An attack that pulls the target toward the attacker.

effects.actionDescription: You fling out a hooked barb that strikes the target and attempt to pull them closer.

save.failure: Target is pulled toward you 2 Spaces.

name: Healing Burst
featureDescription: A healing effect targeting every creature around the caster.

effects.actionDescription: A burst of healing light shines around you, healing any creature it touches.

name: Fey Step
featureDescription: Short range teleport.

effects.actionDescription: You teleport to a location of your choice within 4 Spaces.

name: Wing Blast
featureDescription: Push away creatures close to the user.

check.success: Push each target 1 Space directly away from you.

name: Whirlwind
featureDescription: A martial AoE attack hitting all adjacent creatures.

effects.actionDescription: You spin while wildly attacking in all directions.

name: Rallying Cry
featureDescription: Grant allies ADV on their next check.

effects.actionDescription: You yell out to your allies, granting them ADV on their next check.

name: Arcane Push
featureDescription: Push targets 1 Space.

effects.actionDescription: You weave the arcane into a solid force that pushes the target 1 Space in any horizontal direction.

name: Charge
featureDescription: Required by other features. Charge up for a big move.

effects.actionDescription: You spend some time to charge up for a big move.

name: Charged Radiance
featureDescription: AoE line attack. Requires: Charge.

effects.actionDescription: Requires Charge. A bright line of radiant light burns a path in front of you.

save.failure: Targets are Blinded until the end of your next round.

name: Stab and Run
featureDescription: Reaction: Attack and move when a hostile creature attacks you.
reactionTrigger: When a hostile creature makes an attack action within 1 Space of you

effects.actionDescription: After the attack you move up to your Speed without causing opportunity attacks.

name: Wall of Earth
featureDescription: Conjure a 4 Space long, 2 Space tall earthen wall.

effects.actionDescription: Conjure a 4 Space long, 2 Space tall wall of earth that fills an unoccupied area within 5 Spaces. The wall has PD 15, AD 15, 3 HP, and resistance 1 to Physical damage.
effects.target: a 4 Space line (2 Space tall wall)

name: Earth Spike
featureDescription: Ranged spell attack that conjures a spike of earth.

name: Gemantic Aura (3 Spaces)
featureDescription: You emanate an aura of control over earth within a 3 Space Aura.

effects.text: When you cast spells you can do so as if you were standing in any Space over earth in your Aura, and any creature within your Aura has DisADV on Saves against you.

name: Earth Walker
featureDescription: You're not affected by Difficult Terrain created by rock, dirt, mud, or sand.

effects.text: Ignore Difficult Terrain created by rock, dirt, mud, or sand.

name: Relentless
featureDescription: This creature refuses to fall.

effects.text: When reduced to 0 HP for the first time in combat, you instead drop to 1 HP. This effect can only occur once per encounter.

name: Bone Crusher
featureDescription: Grappled foes are crushed mercilessly.

effects.text: Creatures you Grapple take 2 Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of your turns.

name: Heavy Strike
featureDescription: A devastating overhead blow that can topple even sturdy opponents.

effects.actionDescription: You bring down a crushing blow with all your might.

save.failure: The target is knocked Prone.

name: Lunge
featureDescription: Charge forward and drive your weapon into your foe.

effects.range: 3 Spaces (must move at least 2 Spaces toward target first)
effects.actionDescription: You surge forward, adding momentum to your strike.

name: Tremor Strike
featureDescription: Slam the ground, sending shockwaves through the earth.

effects.actionDescription: You drive your fist or weapon into the ground, sending a shockwave rippling outward.

save.failure: The target is knocked Prone.

name: Grapple
featureDescription: Seize and hold a creature in place.

effects.actionDescription: You reach out and attempt to seize the target.

check.successEach5: Extend the Grapple's effective range by 1 Space.

name: War Cry
featureDescription: A terrifying battle cry that shakes the resolve of your enemies.

effects.actionDescription: You unleash a thunderous roar. Each creature you target must make a Cha Save or become Frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

name: Haymaker Throw
featureDescription: Hurl a Grappled creature into another target.

effects.actionDescription: You hurl a Grappled creature up to 3 Spaces. If it collides with another creature, both take Bludgeoning damage equal to your base damage. Requires: Grapple.

name: Body Block
featureDescription: Throw yourself in the path of an attack targeting an ally.
reactionTrigger: When an ally within 1 Space of you is targeted by an attack

effects.actionDescription: You shove your ally aside and become the target of the triggering attack instead.

name: Sharpshooter
featureDescription: Precise aim cuts through cover and leaves lasting wounds.

effects.text: Your ranged attacks ignore cover bonuses to PD and AD. When your ranged attack deals damage, the target gains the Bleeding condition.

name: Sniper Shot
featureDescription: A precise shot aimed at exposed weak points from long distance.

effects.actionDescription: You line up a perfect shot. You must not have moved this turn.

name: Explosive Arrow
featureDescription: An arrow tipped with a volatile substance that detonates on impact.

effects.actionDescription: You fire an arrow that explodes on impact in a burst of fire and shrapnel.

save.failure: The target gains the Burning condition.

name: Chain Shot
featureDescription: A weighted shot that passes through multiple enemies in a line.

effects.target: up to 2 creatures in a line
effects.actionDescription: You fire a spinning chain shot that tears through enemies in a straight path.

name: Suppressive Fire
featureDescription: Lay down a hail of fire to pin enemies in place.

effects.actionDescription: You flood an area with projectiles. The area becomes Difficult Terrain until the start of your next turn. Creatures moving through it make an Agi Save or become Hindered.

check.success: The area is Difficult Terrain and creatures moving through it make an Agi Save or become Hindered.

name: Smoke Arrow
featureDescription: Fire an arrow that bursts into concealing smoke on impact.

effects.actionDescription: You fire a smoke arrow that erupts into a thick cloud. The area is Heavily Obscured until the start of your next turn.

name: Scatter Caltrops
featureDescription: Scatter spiked caltrops across the battlefield.

effects.actionDescription: You scatter caltrops in the area. It becomes Difficult Terrain. Any creature that enters the area for the first time on its turn takes 1 Piercing damage.

name: Aura of Dread
featureDescription: The creature exudes an aura of supernatural terror.

effects.text: Creatures that start their turn within 3 Spaces of you must make a Cha Save or become Frightened of you until the start of their next turn.

name: Lingering Curse
featureDescription: Failed saves leave lingering marks on the target.

effects.text: When a creature fails a Save against one of your effects, it has DisADV on its next Save against your effects.

name: Mindbreak
featureDescription: A focused psychic assault that overloads the target's mind.

effects.actionDescription: You unleash a bolt of psychic energy that shatters concentration.

save.failure: The target is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

name: Gravity Well
featureDescription: Create a gravitational anomaly that drags creatures toward a point.

effects.actionDescription: You create a crushing gravitational field. Each creature in the area makes a Mig Save or is pulled 2 Spaces toward the center and becomes Hindered until the end of its next turn.

check.success: Affect all creatures in the area.

name: Frost Nova
featureDescription: An explosion of freezing energy that encases nearby enemies in ice.

effects.actionDescription: A burst of intense cold erupts from you, freezing everything nearby.

save.failure: The target gains the Slowed condition until the end of its next turn.

name: Mass Confusion
featureDescription: Scramble the senses of multiple creatures at once.

effects.actionDescription: You flood the minds of your targets with disorienting illusions. Each target makes an Int Save or becomes Disoriented until the end of its next turn.

name: Guardian Stance
featureDescription: The creature's presence bolsters nearby allies.

effects.text: Allies within 1 Space of you gain +1 to PD and AD.

name: Stalwart
featureDescription: This creature cannot be easily moved or shaken.

effects.text: You cannot be knocked Prone or moved against your will by non-magical means. When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you may make a free melee attack against it as a Reaction.

name: Shield Slam
featureDescription: Smash into a foe with your shield, knocking them off balance.

effects.actionDescription: You drive your shield into the target with crushing force.

save.failure: The target is knocked Prone and pushed 1 Space directly away from you.

name: Sweeping Guard
featureDescription: A wide arc attack that punishes all creatures within reach.

effects.actionDescription: You sweep your weapon in a wide arc, striking all who approach.

name: Retributive Strike
featureDescription: Strike back when an ally near you is attacked.
reactionTrigger: When a creature within 1 Space of you deals damage to an ally

effects.actionDescription: You immediately lash back at any creature that strikes your allies.

name: Taunt Strike
featureDescription: A calculated blow meant to draw the enemy's focus.

effects.actionDescription: You strike the target with a goading blow, forcing their attention onto you.

save.failure: The target gains the Taunted condition, targeting only you with its next attack.

name: Interpose
featureDescription: Throw yourself between an attack and an ally.
reactionTrigger: When an ally within 1 Space of you is targeted by an attack

effects.actionDescription: You step into the path of the attack, becoming the target instead. The attack targets your PD or AD (same defense as originally targeted).

name: Fortress Stance
featureDescription: Plant your feet and become an immovable wall.

effects.actionDescription: Until the start of your next turn, you gain +3 PD and AD, but your Speed becomes 0. You also cannot be moved or knocked Prone.

name: Ambush Predator
featureDescription: The creature excels at striking from concealment.

effects.text: Your attacks deal +3 damage against creatures that have not yet acted in combat or that are unaware of you.

name: Shadow Step
featureDescription: This creature flickers between patches of shadow with supernatural ease.

effects.text: Once per turn, when you move through dim light or darkness, you may attempt to Hide as part of that movement.

name: Backstab
featureDescription: Drive a blade into an exposed flank for devastating effect.

effects.actionDescription: You find an opening and drive your weapon deep. This attack has ADV if you are Hidden from the target or if an ally is adjacent to it.

name: Garrote
featureDescription: Loop a cord around the target's neck and choke.

effects.actionDescription: You seize the target from behind. On a hit, the target is Grappled. While Grappled this way, the target makes an Agi Save at the end of each of its turns or becomes Incapacitated.

save.failure: The target is Grappled.

name: Poison Strike
featureDescription: A swift strike coated in potent toxin.

effects.actionDescription: You strike quickly with a venomous weapon.

save.failure: The target gains the Poisoned condition.

name: Shadow Pounce
featureDescription: Leap from the shadows and slam into your prey.

effects.actionDescription: You emerge from concealment in a deadly leap. You move up to 4 Spaces toward the target as part of this action.

save.failure: The target is knocked Prone and Dazed until end of its next turn.

name: Smoke Cloud
featureDescription: Conjure a thick cloud of smoke to obscure the battlefield.

effects.actionDescription: You create a cloud of dense smoke. The area is Heavily Obscured until the start of your next turn.

name: Shadow Meld
featureDescription: Merge with nearby shadows, becoming impossible to see.

effects.actionDescription: You step into a shadow and become Invisible until the start of your next turn or until you make an attack or cast a spell.

name: Aura of Vitality
featureDescription: This creature's presence accelerates the healing of nearby allies.

effects.text: Allies that start their turn within 2 Spaces of you regain 1 HP.

name: Inspiring Presence
featureDescription: The creature's courage shores up the resolve of nearby allies.

effects.text: Allies within 2 Spaces of you have ADV on Saves against the Frightened and Charmed conditions.

name: Holy Smite
featureDescription: Channel divine radiance into a searing bolt of light.

effects.actionDescription: You hurl a bolt of holy light at your enemy. Against Undead and Fiends, this attack deals +2 additional Radiant damage.

name: Binding Bolt
featureDescription: A crackling bolt of energy that locks the target in place.

effects.actionDescription: You hurl a bolt of crackling binding energy.

save.failure: The target is Restrained until the end of its next turn.

name: Sacred Flame
featureDescription: A burst of divine fire that purges corruption from a wide area.

effects.actionDescription: Divine flames erupt in a sphere, burning all enemies within.

save.failure: The target is Blinded until the end of its next turn.

name: Bless
featureDescription: Call down divine favor on your allies.

effects.actionDescription: You invoke divine blessing on your allies. Each target gains ADV on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.

name: Divine Shield
featureDescription: Cloak an ally in protective divine energy.

effects.actionDescription: You weave a divine barrier around an ally. The target gains +3 PD and AD until the start of your next turn.

name: Undying
featureDescription: This creature refuses to stay dead.

effects.text: When reduced to 0 HP for the first time in combat, this creature instead drops to 1 HP. This effect can only occur once per encounter. The creature must be fully destroyed (reduced to 0 HP a second time) to be permanently slain.

name: Undead Resilience
featureDescription: The creature's undead nature grants immunity to certain afflictions.

name: Life Drain
featureDescription: Drain the vital essence from a creature to fuel your own unlife.

effects.actionDescription: You reach out and draw the life force from your target. You regain HP equal to the damage dealt.

name: Terrifying Visage
featureDescription: Reveal your true undead nature to strike terror into the living.

effects.actionDescription: You unveil the horror of your undead form. Each living creature in range must make a Cha Save or become Frightened of you until the end of its next turn.

check.successEach5: Affected creatures are Frightened for 1 minute instead.

name: Necrotic Aura
featureDescription: Death radiates from this creature's form.

effects.text: Creatures that start their turn within 2 Spaces of you take 1 Necrotic damage.

name: Frightful Presence
featureDescription: The dragon's sheer presence terrifies lesser creatures.

effects.text: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 Spaces of you that is aware of you must make a Cha Save or become Frightened of you until the start of its next turn. A creature that succeeds is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

name: Dragon Scales
featureDescription: Thick draconic scales provide exceptional natural armor.

name: Fire Breath
featureDescription: Unleash a devastating cone of scorching dragonfire.

effects.actionDescription: You exhale a torrent of fire from your jaws.

save.failure: The target gains the Burning condition.

name: Claw Rake
featureDescription: Tear through a target with both claws in a raking strike.

effects.actionDescription: You slash across your target twice in quick succession.

name: Wing Sweep
featureDescription: Beat your massive wings to scatter nearby creatures.

effects.actionDescription: You beat your wings in a powerful sweep. Each creature in range makes a Mig Save or is pushed 3 Spaces directly away from you and knocked Prone.

name: Infernal Resilience
featureDescription: Born of hellfire, this creature shrugs off flame and poison.

name: Dark Pact
featureDescription: Striking this creature is a dangerous bargain.

effects.text: Whenever a creature deals damage to you, it takes 1 Fire damage.

name: Hellfire Bolt
featureDescription: Hurl a bolt of crackling hellfire at a distant foe.

effects.actionDescription: You hurl a bolt of infernal flame.

save.failure: The target gains the Burning condition.

name: Hellfire Burst
featureDescription: Summon a pillar of infernal fire to immolate an area.

effects.actionDescription: A column of hellfire erupts from the ground, scorching everything within.

save.failure: The target gains the Burning condition.

name: Infernal Gaze
featureDescription: Lock eyes with a creature and overwhelm their will.

effects.actionDescription: You fix your infernal gaze upon a creature. It makes a Cha Save or becomes Charmed by you until the end of its next turn. While Charmed this way, it regards you as a trusted ally.

check.success: The target is Charmed until the end of its next turn.
check.successEach5: The Charmed duration increases by 1 round.

name: Thick Hide
featureDescription: Dense fur, scales, or chitinous plating absorbs punishment.

name: Pack Hunter
featureDescription: This creature coordinates with its packmates to bring down prey.

effects.text: When you make an attack against a creature that has an ally of yours adjacent to it, you deal +2 damage.

name: Pounce
featureDescription: Leap onto your prey, bearing them to the ground.

effects.range: 3 Spaces (must move at least 2 Spaces toward target first)
effects.actionDescription: You leap at your target and crash into them with your full weight.

save.failure: The target is knocked Prone.

name: Venomous Bite
featureDescription: Sink venomous fangs into the target.

effects.actionDescription: You sink your fangs into the target, injecting venom.

save.failure: The target gains the Poisoned condition.

name: Fierce Roar
featureDescription: Let out a thunderous roar to shake nearby enemies.

effects.actionDescription: You unleash a bone-shaking roar. Creatures in range make a Cha Save or become Frightened until the end of their next turn.

check.successEach5: Affected creatures are Frightened for 1 additional round.

name: Aberrant Resilience
featureDescription: The creature's alien biology resists mental manipulation.

name: Psychic Aura
featureDescription: This creature's alien mind bleeds into the thoughts of those nearby.

effects.text: Creatures within 2 Spaces of you that take damage must make an Int Save or become Disoriented until the start of their next turn.

name: Mind Blast
featureDescription: Project a psychic shockwave that staggers all who feel it.

effects.actionDescription: You project a devastating wave of psychic energy from your mind.

save.failure: The target is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

name: Tentacle Grab
featureDescription: Lash out with a powerful tentacle to restrain prey.

effects.actionDescription: You whip a tentacle toward a creature, attempting to wrap it up.

save.failure: The target is Restrained. It can free itself with a DC 12 Mig Check on its turn.

name: Void Gaze
featureDescription: Fix your unfathomable gaze on a creature, filling them with existential dread.

effects.actionDescription: You fix your alien gaze upon a creature. It makes an Int Save or becomes Frightened and Disoriented until the end of its next turn.

check.success: Target is Frightened and Disoriented until end of its next turn.
check.successEach5: The target is also Stunned for 1 round.

name: Plant Resilience
featureDescription: The creature's plant nature grants unusual resistances.

name: Photosynthesis
featureDescription: This creature draws strength from natural light.

effects.text: While in sunlight or bright natural light, you regain 1 HP at the start of each of your turns.

name: Vine Grapple
featureDescription: Shoot out binding vines to entangle a target.

effects.actionDescription: You launch a bundle of fast-growing vines toward your target.

save.failure: The target is Restrained until the end of its next turn.
save.failureEach5: The Restrained duration increases by 1 round.

name: Thorn Lash
featureDescription: Whip a barbed vine at a creature, tearing through flesh.

effects.actionDescription: You lash out with a thorned vine, raking across the target.

save.failure: The target gains the Bleeding condition.

name: Spore Cloud
featureDescription: Release a cloud of toxic spores to sicken nearby creatures.

effects.actionDescription: You release a burst of toxic spores. The area becomes Heavily Obscured and Difficult Terrain. Creatures that start their turn in the area make a Mig Save or gain the Poisoned condition.

name: Celestial Resilience
featureDescription: Blessed by divine power, this creature resists dark energies and cannot be charmed or frightened.

name: Radiant Aura
featureDescription: Divine light radiates from this creature, searing enemies that draw near.

effects.text: Creatures that start their turn within 2 Spaces of you take 1 Radiant damage.

name: Celestial Wings
featureDescription: Magnificent wings grant this creature the gift of flight.

effects.text: This creature has a Fly Speed equal to its Speed. While airborne, creatures cannot gain flanking bonuses against it.

name: Divine Judgment
featureDescription: Channel divine wrath into a melee strike of blinding radiance.

effects.actionDescription: You channel divine wrath into your touch, lashing out with searing holy light.

save.failure: The target is Blinded until the end of its next turn.

name: Fey Resilience
featureDescription: The creature's fey nature makes it resistant to poison and immune to enchantment.

name: Glamour
featureDescription: This creature's fey glamour makes it hard to perceive clearly in combat.

effects.text: The first time each creature attacks you in a combat encounter, that attack has DisADV. Once a creature successfully hits you, this effect ends for that creature.

name: Beguiling Gaze
featureDescription: Fix your shimmering fey eyes on a creature, bending its will.

effects.actionDescription: Your eyes shimmer with fey magic as you fix your gaze on a creature, bending its will.

check.success: Target is Charmed by you until the end of its next turn.
check.successEach5: The Charmed duration increases by 1 round.

name: Fey Curse
featureDescription: Whisper a fey curse that twists luck against the target.

effects.actionDescription: You weave a whispered curse of misfortune over the target.

check.success: Target has DisADV on its next attack roll or Save.
check.successEach5: Target has DisADV on 1 additional roll.

name: Giant Resilience
featureDescription: Massive frame and dense muscle grant exceptional endurance.

name: Titanic Strength
featureDescription: This creature's immense size lets it overpower creatures much larger than normal.

effects.text: You can Grapple creatures of any size. Your Grapple checks have ADV.

name: Boulder Throw
featureDescription: Tear a massive rock from the earth and hurl it at a distant foe.

effects.actionDescription: You hurl an enormous boulder with crushing force.

save.failure: The target is knocked Prone.
save.failureEach5: The target is also pushed 1 Space directly away from you.

name: Stomp
featureDescription: Crash a massive foot down, sending shockwaves through the ground.

effects.actionDescription: You bring your massive foot down with earth-shaking force.

save.failure: The target is knocked Prone.

name: Ooze Resilience
featureDescription: The creature's amorphous body redistributes impacts and resists many afflictions.

name: Amorphous
featureDescription: This creature has no fixed form and can squeeze through incredibly small spaces.

effects.text: You can move through any space at least 1 inch wide without squeezing. You are immune to the Grappled and Prone conditions.

name: Pseudopod
featureDescription: Lash out with a mass of caustic ooze, engulfing the target.

effects.actionDescription: You extend a mass of your body, slamming into the target with corrosive force.

save.failure: The target is Grappled.

name: Acid Splash
featureDescription: Spray a burst of corrosive acid on nearby creatures.

effects.actionDescription: You expel a spray of caustic acid in a short burst.

save.failure: The target gains the Poisoned condition.

name: Opportunity Shot
featureDescription: Fire at an enemy the moment they drop their guard or flee.
reactionTrigger: When a creature within your ranged attack range moves out of a Space adjacent to an ally

effects.actionDescription: You seize the opening as the enemy exposes themselves.

name: Arcane Interrupt
featureDescription: Disrupt an enemy ability with a psychic lash before it takes effect.
reactionTrigger: When a creature within 8 Spaces uses an ability that involves a check or save

effects.actionDescription: You project a burst of disruptive energy, hampering the triggering ability.

check.success: The ability's check or save has DisADV.
check.successEach5: The target is also Disoriented until the end of its turn.

name: Protective Ward
featureDescription: Shield an ally from incoming harm with a burst of divine energy.
reactionTrigger: When an ally within 3 Spaces takes damage

effects.actionDescription: You extend a barrier of divine energy around a nearby ally, halving the damage they take.

name: Evasive Step
featureDescription: Dart out of reach the moment an attacker commits to their strike.
reactionTrigger: When you are targeted by a melee attack

effects.actionDescription: You flicker out of reach before the attack lands, stepping up to 1 Space in any direction. The attack still resolves at your new position.

name: Savage Retaliation
featureDescription: Instinctively lash out when hurt, driven by pure predator instinct.
reactionTrigger: When a creature within 1 Space deals damage to you

effects.actionDescription: Pain triggers pure instinct — you slash or bite at whatever hurt you.

name: Death Throes
featureDescription: When struck down, unleash one final attack before falling.
reactionTrigger: When you would be reduced to 0 HP

effects.actionDescription: Even as destruction takes you, you lash out with undying fury. This attack resolves before you fall.

name: Wing Buffer
featureDescription: Beat your wings when struck in melee, sending the attacker stumbling back.
reactionTrigger: When a creature within 1 Space hits you with a melee attack

effects.actionDescription: You beat your wings hard, catching the attacker with the force and pushing them away.

name: Hellish Rebuke
featureDescription: When hurt, point a finger and call down infernal fire on the attacker.
reactionTrigger: When a creature deals damage to you

effects.actionDescription: You point at the creature that harmed you and speak a word of infernal power. Flames erupt around them.

name: Elemental Retaliation
featureDescription: When struck, discharge a burst of raw elemental energy at the attacker.
reactionTrigger: When a creature within 5 Spaces deals damage to you

effects.actionDescription: A burst of raw elemental force erupts toward your attacker. Change the damage type to match this elemental's element.

name: Thorn Burst
featureDescription: When struck in melee, razor thorns snap outward to punish the attacker.
reactionTrigger: When a creature within 1 Space hits you with a melee attack

effects.actionDescription: Razor-sharp thorns snap outward when you are struck, punishing the attacker.

name: Iron Parry
featureDescription: Position your rigid body to deflect an incoming blow.

effects.actionDescription: You angle your hardened body to deflect the strike, gaining +3 PD and AD against the triggering attack.

name: Mighty Swat
featureDescription: Swat away a creature that dares strike you in melee.
reactionTrigger: When a creature within 1 Space hits you with a melee attack

effects.actionDescription: You swipe at the attacker with overwhelming force, sending them flying.

name: Engulf
featureDescription: When struck in melee, surge outward and attempt to engulf the attacker.
reactionTrigger: When a creature within 1 Space hits you with a melee attack

effects.actionDescription: Your form surges outward, attempting to envelop the attacker.

save.failure: The target is Restrained.

name: Divine Constitution
featureDescription: Divine grace fortifies this creature's body, reinforcing its defenses and making it harder to wound.

name: Sanctuary Aura
featureDescription: This creature radiates a protective divine presence that bolsters the resolve and resilience of nearby allies.

effects.text: Allied creatures within 3 Spaces of you add +1 to all their Save rolls.

name: Holy Charge
featureDescription: The celestial bursts forward in a line of divine light, scattering enemies from its path.

effects.target: all creatures in a 4 Space Line
effects.actionDescription: You charge up to 4 Spaces in a straight line. Each creature in your path is pushed 1 Space to either side.

check.failure: Creatures are pushed but remain standing.
check.success: Pushed creatures are also knocked Prone.

name: Faerie Dart
featureDescription: A swift dart of raw fey magic — cheap and accurate, the signature attack of lesser fey.

effects.actionDescription: You flick a mote of crackling fey magic at your target.

name: Thornwhip
featureDescription: The creature lashes out with a vine of living thorns that can snag and hold its prey.

effects.actionDescription: You snap a thorned vine at a creature within 2 Spaces.

save.failure: The target is Grappled until the start of your next turn.

name: Moonfire Burst
featureDescription: The creature releases a burst of searing silver moonlight that blinds those caught in it.

effects.actionDescription: You release a pulse of cold silver fire that erupts at a point within range.

save.failure: The target is Blinded until the end of its next turn.

name: Unseelie Vitality
featureDescription: Exposure to the dark half of the Fey Plane toughens this creature against poison and the cold.

name: Wild Heart
featureDescription: This creature's fey instincts let it dart out of reach the instant an attack goes wide.

effects.text: Once per round, when a creature misses you with an attack, you may immediately move up to 2 Spaces as a free action. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.

name: Acrobatic Sprint
featureDescription: The creature dashes with fey swiftness, weaving through enemies without giving them an opening.

effects.actionDescription: You move up to your Speed. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.

name: Thick Hide
featureDescription: Layers of dense skin and muscle shrug off crushing blows that would fell lesser creatures.

name: Immovable
featureDescription: This creature's sheer mass makes it impossible to shove, push, or topple.

effects.text: This creature cannot be involuntarily moved by creature abilities or effects, and automatically succeeds on saves caused by Bull Rush, Shove, or similar physical displacement. It is also immune to the Prone condition from external sources.

name: Primal Surge
featureDescription: The giant channels raw primal magic into the earth, sending a shockwave outward to topple nearby enemies.

effects.actionDescription: You slam the ground and release a surge of primal energy. All enemies within 2 Spaces are knocked Prone.

check.success: All enemies within 2 Spaces are knocked Prone.

name: Viscous Mass
featureDescription: This ooze's bulk has grown to an almost incomprehensible size, absorbing more damage before collapsing.

name: Split
featureDescription: When cut in half, this ooze does not die — it becomes two oozes.

effects.text: The first time this creature is reduced to half its maximum HP, it splits. A second ooze with HP equal to the triggering creature's current HP appears in an adjacent unoccupied space, sharing this creature's remaining statistics.

name: Smother
featureDescription: The ooze presses its full mass over a grappled creature, suffocating it in acidic slime.

effects.actionDescription: You press down onto a Grappled creature, smothering it in acidic bulk.

check.success: The target is Restrained and takes 1 Poison damage at the start of each of its turns until it escapes the Grapple.

name: Viscous Trail
featureDescription: The ooze secretes a burning slick of acid as it moves, turning its path into a hazard.

effects.actionDescription: Until the end of your turn, each Space you move through is coated in corrosive slime. Any creature that enters a coated Space takes 1 Corrosive damage. Coated Spaces are Difficult Terrain until the start of your next turn.
